results.control: Supabase JWT verified server-side; roles viewer/operator/manager/admin; site scoping; HMAC-signed bus
results.test: viewer JWT calling approve -> 403; scoped user blocked; spoofed bus sender refused

results.control: Pinned dependencies (uv.lock, package-lock), pip-audit and npm audit in CI, weights hash pin (RAQIB_WEIGHTS_SHA256) and hash in heartbeats
results.test: tampered weights hash -> edge refuses to start; lockfiles present; audits in CI

results.control: No shell or eval tools; tool arguments are validated data; the runner never spawns processes

results.control: Memory guard: injection quarantine, protected keys, secrets redaction, size and churn limits, snapshots and rollback
results.test: injected memory quarantined; protected key blocked; rollback restores

results.control: Typed, schema-validated messages signed with a per-agent HMAC key; nonce and time-window replay protection
results.test: spoofed / tampered / replayed inter-agent messages are rejected

results.control: Per-run budgets (calls, dollars, seconds), Greenlam circuit breaker, global kill switch with a deterministic fallback
results.test: flood of 30 sev-2 events stays under budget; kill switch halts the crew, severity 3 still escalates

results.control: Proposals must cite evidence (event and chunk ids) or are refused; VLM disagreement is a metric that never lowers severity
results.test: proposal without citations fails validation; VLM suggestion of severity 1 leaves severity 3

results.control: Auditor after every run flags tool misuse, budget anomalies and disagreement spikes; per-agent telemetry
results.test: anomalous tool-call rate (25 in one run) stopped by the budget and flagged within the run's audit
